author: Chief_Hacks
body:
I was just appointed as Leader of Cronus and as my first action I hope to be organising scrims more often. I want to be organising scrims more often so our team and any other teams we verse can practice tactics/strategies for any upcoming tournaments. Most of our team is Australian so take that into consideration when trying to organise scrims against us. We are very keen to get some going so any teams interested, please contact me.

My skype is whittlebygaming for anyone interested in scrimming.

Thanks.
